                        target=keyboard. A bare value applies to the single
                        target control component. (default: [])

entry_points.name: protomotions-train-agent
entry_points.stdout:
usage: train_agent.py [-h] --robot-name ROBOT_NAME --simulator SIMULATOR
                      --num-envs NUM_ENVS --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                      --motion-file MOTION_FILE --experiment-path
                      EXPERIMENT_PATH --experiment-name EXPERIMENT_NAME
                      [--scenes-file SCENES_FILE] [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                      [--use-wandb] [--wandb-project WANDB_PROJECT]
                      [--use-slurm] [--ngpu NGPU] [--nodes NODES]
                      [--headless [HEADLESS]] [--seed SEED]
                      [--torch-deterministic]
                      [--training-max-steps TRAINING_MAX_STEPS | --training-max-iterations TRAINING_MAX_ITERATIONS]
                      [--overrides [OVERRIDES ...]] [--create-config-only]

Train reinforcement learning agent with configurable parameters

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --robot-name ROBOT_NAME
                        Name of the robot (e.g., 'g1', 'smpl') (default: None)
  --simulator SIMULATOR
                        Simulator to use (e.g., 'isaacgym', 'isaaclab',
                        'newton', 'genesis') (default: None)
  --num-envs NUM_ENVS   Number of parallel environments to run (default: None)
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Batch size for training (default: None)
  --motion-file MOTION_FILE
                        Path to motion file for training (default: None)
  --experiment-path EXPERIMENT_PATH
                        File path to experiment configuration (e.g.,
                        'examples/train/mimic/mimic_mlp.py') (default: None)
  --experiment-name EXPERIMENT_NAME
                        Name of the experiment for logging and checkpointing
                        (default: None)
  --scenes-file SCENES_FILE
                        Path to scenes file (optional) (default: None)
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        Path to checkpoint file to resume from (default: None)
  --use-wandb           Enable Weights & Biases logging (default: False)
  --wandb-project WANDB_PROJECT
                        Weights & Biases project name (default:
                        physical_animation)
  --use-slurm           Enable SLURM autoresume functionality (default: False)
  --ngpu NGPU           Number of GPUs to use for training (default: 1)
  --nodes NODES         Number of nodes for distributed training (default: 1)
  --headless [HEADLESS]
                        Run simulation in headless mode (default: True)
  --seed SEED           Random seed for reproducibility (default: 0)
  --torch-deterministic
                        Enable deterministic PyTorch operations (default:
                        False)
  --training-max-steps TRAINING_MAX_STEPS
                        Maximum number of training steps. Default to 'loads of
                        steps'. (default: 10000000000000)
  --training-max-iterations TRAINING_MAX_ITERATIONS
                        Maximum number of complete training iterations. Each
                        iteration collects one rollout and performs its
                        optimization updates. (default: None)
  --overrides [OVERRIDES ...]
                        Config overrides in format key=value (e.g.,
                        env.max_episode_length=1000 simulator.num_envs=4096)
                        (default: [])
  --create-config-only  Only create and save config files without training.
                        Useful for migrating old policy checkpoints when
                        config system API changes - generate new configs that
                        are compatible with current code, then load old
                        weights. (default: False)

                         ...

Unified source-checkout commands; native execution retains its owning
launcher.

positional arguments:
  {status,preflight,simulate,train-amp,record,evaluate-speed,evaluate-posture,evaluate-physics,evaluate-stasis,audit-speed,audit-feet,audit-camera,baseline-train,baseline-evaluate}
    status              Show project locations and the latest completed
                        release
    preflight           Resource-only preflight
    simulate            Owned native physical execution
    train-amp           Forward arguments to finetune_pacer_amass_verified.py
    record              Forward arguments to record_pedestrian_coverage.py
    evaluate-speed      Forward arguments to
                        evaluate_trace_pace_speed_coverage.py
    evaluate-posture    Forward arguments to evaluate_trace_pace_posture.py
    evaluate-physics    Forward arguments to
                        evaluate_trace_pace_reliability.py
    evaluate-stasis     Forward arguments to
                        evaluate_trace_pace_spatial_stasis.py
    audit-speed         Forward arguments to audit_trace_pace_substep_speed.py
    audit-feet          Forward arguments to audit_trace_pace_foot_surface.py
    audit-camera        Forward arguments to audit_trace_pace_camera_skin.py
    baseline-train      Simulator-free PointGoal PPO
    baseline-evaluate   Simulator-free PointGoal PPO

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
